definitions.short: companionship ; hence (concretely) a comrade or kindred man
definitions.full: H5997. amith [ עָמִית ] noun masculine Lev 18:20 associate, fellow, relation (perhaps originally feminine abstract association , compare מֶּחָה ); — always suffix: עֲמִיתִי גֶּבֶר Zech 13:7 a man (who is) my fellow ; elsewhere only Leviticus: עֲמִיתוֺ Zechariah 5:21 (twice in verse); reciprocal בַּעֲמִיתוֺ אִישׁ Zech 19:11; Zech 24:19, cf . Zech 25:17; עֲמִיתְךָ Zech 18:20, עֲמִיתֶ֑ךָ Zech 19:15; Zech 19:17; Zech 25:14 (twice in verse); Zech 25:15. עַמִּיאֵל and similar proper names see below I. עמם .
definitions.rootNote: from a primitive root meaning to associate ;
